environment.target: current-worktree dev-electron-test; fresh process for each final control

method: Start a fresh target process and focus exactly one disposable control with a control-unique fixture.

Run electron-native-undo-check.swift <control> --write-only. The driver gates bundle, frontmost PID, window title, focused role, element identity and exact original, writes AXValue once, and requires exact replacement readback.
Run the independent --verify-original process. It checks role and the control-unique value with bounded read-only waiting up to 2 seconds; no write or auto-restore is performed.
Restart the target process before the next control to eliminate prior undo history.

positive_control.purpose: Prove the external Cmd-Z path is delivered and effective inside this Electron target, independent of AXValue writes.
positive_control.action: External keyboard typing inserted X at the start of the input fixture; AX readback observed Xbe-nice M0 fixture: hello world. [input]. One external Cmd-Z followed.
positive_control.result: PASS: independent AX readback restored be-nice M0 fixture: hello world. [input].

results.write: AXError=0; exact replacement read back; READY
results.verification_output: STOP: undo UNCONFIRMED; current=be-nice M0 fixture: hello world. [input] [be-nice-undo]
results.result: FAIL: exact replacement remained after bounded verification

cleanup: The contenteditable replacement was explicitly restored after a fresh AX snapshot; all three controls independently read back their exact unique fixtures. Restoration is cleanup, not undo evidence.
superseded_trials: Earlier common-fixture trials without an Electron keyboard positive control also failed, but are superseded by the final fresh-process, unique-fixture, bounded-wait trials above.
An earlier non-isolated textarea attempt undid a previous input setup action and was discarded.
An old Electron instance loaded files from the main checkout; all final trials used newly launched current-worktree processes.
scope: Only AXValue writes to fixed ASCII fixtures in this Electron test target. The positive control supports Cmd-Z delivery; the three failures show those AXValue writes were not natively undone in these trials. Does not test SelectedText undo, Slack/VS Code, Unicode/IME/rich-text formatting, redo or repeated undo. Product-managed original-text restoration remains required and is not evidence of native undo support.
